claims_supported: Normal wheat sowing time for Haryana recommended as 25 Oct-15 Nov instead of 1-25 Nov
notes: Existence and the sowing-time sentence confirmed from a search excerpt; the full PDF could not be opened. Publication date is not printed in the excerpt (the numeric file name suggests a ~2018 upload, which is NOT a verified date), so the advice may predate newer early-sowing varieties. The same excerpt mentions seed treatment for loose smut with a named fungicide; it was NOT used because registration, dose-stage and region checks were not possible.
